name: Silver Thread's 35th Anniversary Dinner
blurb: A five-course, locally sourced dinner paired with Silver Thread wines, including sparkling and library selections. Reservations required.

name: Southeast Seneca Disc Golf Classic
blurb: A day of disc golf at Grist Iron, sponsored by Southeast Seneca businesses with giveaways and prizes at every hole.

name: Red Cat's Harvest Party
blurb: Great wine, three live acts, food trucks, vendors, lawn games and raffles benefiting the local fire department. Free admission, case discounts all day.

name: Balloons on the Ridge
blurb: Hot air balloon weekend: sunset and sunrise flights, tethered rides, a balloon glow, three live music acts and food trucks. Free admission, $10 parking.

name: Solera Oktoberfest
blurb: Festbier tap takeover, festive food, lawn games and three bands from noon to close. Free to get in, and the stein holding competition kicks off at 4!

name: Highland Harvest Festival
blurb: Highland cows, Celtic dancers, Highland games, live music and a Scottish menu. Plus the release of their 7 Year Single Malt!

name: Community Tasting
blurb: Seven wine brands, one afternoon. Taste with every maker who crafts wine at Ria's or works with grapes from their farm. $20 a person.
